# Research Directions

My research explores the physics of quantum
and complex photonic systems, connecting
fundamental wave dynamics with emerging
photonic technologies.

## Complex Wave Transport

Understanding light propagation, scattering,
and disorder in complex environments.

## Nonlinear and Non-Hermitian Photonics

Exploring nonlinear interactions, exceptional
points, and programmable photonic dynamics.

## Quantum and Integrated Photonics

Developing photonic platforms and methods
for quantum technologies, secure communication,
and information processing.
